title: Paper Streetlights
lyrics:
I left my jacket on the fire escape
And counted every window still awake
The city hums a song it never learned
A page of paper streetlights, slowly burned

So carry me home through the blue and the rain
I am half a chorus, you are the refrain
If the morning forgets us, let it forget
We were louder than anything the quiet allowed yet

The bus goes by and shakes the window frame
And everything I own still knows your name

title: Concrete Garden
lyrics:
Nothing grows where the pavement cracked
Except the weeds that argue back
I planted names in a broken pot
And watered every single one I forgot

Grow anyway, grow anyway
The sun is rented but it stays
Grow anyway, grow anyway
There is a garden in the grey

title: Long Way to the Signal
lyrics:
Two bars of service on a country road
Singing to a radio that only knows one mode
The map says turn but the map has lied before
I have been lost in better ways than this

So carry me home through the blue and the rain
And wake me when the tower comes again
The long way to the signal is the only way I go
Taking every wrong turn slow

title: Tin Roof Arithmetic
lyrics:
Count the drops before they hit the tin
Subtract the evening, carry what has been
My father taught me numbers in the shed
And every sum came out to go to bed

Rain is just arithmetic out loud
Adding up to nothing but a cloud
Rain is just arithmetic out loud
And I am bad at math and very proud

title: Saltwater Verbs
lyrics:
You conjugate the tide like it will listen
Past tense, future tense, salt on your skin glistens
I speak in nouns, you answer me in waves
A sentence that the undertow forgave

Teach me the verbs that the saltwater keeps
The ones that only say themselves in sleep
Teach me the verbs that the saltwater keeps
And I will learn them slow and I will learn them deep

title: Neon Laundromat
lyrics:
Quarters in my pocket, midnight on the dial
Watching someone else's colours run a while
The dryer turns like a planet with no sun
And I am waiting for the spin cycle to be done

Everything I wore this year is in this machine
Every night I meant to call, every place I have been
Neon on the puddles, humming on the floor
I am cleaner than I was and lonelier than before

title: Borrowed Metronome
lyrics:
I keep a borrowed metronome beside the bed
It ticks out all the arguments we never said
Four four forever, never any rest
A drummer with a bruise inside his chest

Keep time, keep time, even when it hurts
The silence between beats is where the meaning works
Keep time, keep time, until the tempo breaks
And we can call it music for old times' sake

title: Highway Cartography
lyrics:
Drew the exits on my hand in blue
Every mile a promise I would not follow through
The tail lights make a constellation west
And I have been lost in better ways than this

I am drawing highways where the map gave up
Filling in the empty with a paper cup
Of coffee gone cold at a quarter past four
Somewhere between nowhere and your door
